- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% relative to prior peak.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% to avoid missing downward momentum.
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., 70+ → 73+), leading to overshoot; cap forecast at +3% above recent high unless sentiment confirms continuation.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show downward trend, model often fails to correct; apply slight upward bias to counteract overcorrection.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model tends to lag by 1–2 days in reaction to sentiment shifts; align forecast with sentiment peak 1–2 days ahead.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model often misaligns with cycle midpoint; adjust forecast to match sentiment midpoint rather than peak.
